# Omarchy artwork source

The native SVG mark is downloaded from [Omarchy’s official website](https://omarchy.org/brand/omarchy-logo.svg), checked on 2026-10-20. The original path, fill rule, and green color are preserved.

The exported icons are unofficial isometric adaptations. Omarchy / Omacom retains its brand and artwork rights; the SuperIntelligence MIT license does not relicense this mark or grant trademark rights.

Source URL, asset hash, and adaptation notes are recorded in [sources.json](sources.json).
